description: The JSON of the topics report, topics.json, written beside topics.html by the arrangement step once the topics are named (ADR-416, ADR-435), format 2, in one of two shapes: where the topics are inferred, what feeds each topic, the topics no document was placed under and the seed documents feeding no topic; where the profile lists them, each topic with the documents placed under it and the documents linked from it, and the topics no document was placed under.

format.description: The report's own format, raised by a change that removes, renames or retypes a field.

writtenAt.description: The instant it was written, in UTC to the millisecond.

headline.description: The numbers the page states first. Where the topics are inferred: the topics, the seed passages, the topics with no document and the seed documents feeding no topic. Where the profile lists them: the topics, the topics with no document and, once the low-similarity floor ships a value, the documents placed with low similarity.

key.description: Its key: topics, seed-passages, topics-with-no-document, seeds-feeding-no-topic or placed-with-low-similarity.

sections.description: The page's parts in its order: topics, topics-with-no-document, seeds-feeding-no-topic and how-to-read. Where no topic lacks a document, or no seed document feeds no topic, that part holds its one sentence and no table.

text.description: Its paragraphs, as the words a reader reads.

chart.description: Its chart; the page draws none.

table.description: Its table, null where the part has none.

columns.description: Its columns in the page's order. The topics: topic, first-passage, seed-passages, share-of-seed-passages, seed-documents, documents-placed and linked-documents. The topics with no document: topic, first-passage, seed-document and passages. The seed documents feeding no topic: seed-document. Where the profile lists the topics: topic, documents-placed, linked-documents and, once the low-similarity floor ships a value, placed-with-low-similarity; and, for the topics with no document, topic alone.

label.description: Its label, as the page's header reads.

kind.description: Its kind: text for a topic's name and its first passage, path for a seed document, share for the share of seed passages, count for the rest, the documents placed with low similarity among them.

rows.description: Its rows, in the page's order, each a list of cells in the columns' order. A topic's row: its name, its first passage as the seed's path, the word chunk and the passage's number, its passages, their share of every seed passage as a fraction of one to three places, its seed documents, the documents placed under it and the documents placed under another topic that fit it, counted whether or not the topic has a page to link them from. A row of a topic with no document: its name, its first passage, one seed document feeding it and that seed document's passages in it. A seed document feeding no topic: its path.
